name: nutshell
description: Toggleable Claude Code statusline: model/context, rate limits, session cost, workspace, emoji labels. Simple one-line or detailed three-line layout. One command per action: /nutshell:nutshell-show, nutshell-hide, nutshell-emoji, nutshell-mode, nutshell-active, nutshell-inactive, nutshell-status, nutshell-setup, nutshell-uninstall.
